purpose: Catch unroutable floorplan, macro pin escape, and power delivery topology errors that placement cannot fix and that become 2-week rework after CTS

checks.question: Show me macro halo, channel width in rows, and pin alignment to routing tracks — are any channels <2x row height where >100 pins need to escape?
checks.evidence_demanded: Floorplan screenshot with macro halo + pin density heatmap + channel width annotation, and LEF pin-on-track check
checks.red_flag: Channel <20um at 28nm or <10um at 7nm with >50 pins on one edge, or macro pins off-grid by 0.5 track
checks.why_it_matters: If waved, placement will create 5-10% overflow concentrated in that channel, detailed route will never close without macro move

checks.question: Show me PG mesh by layer and distance to nearest C4 bump / power pad — what is worst IR drop from static estimation and where?
checks.evidence_demanded: PG density map by layer M1-M9, bump map overlay, static IR estimation with 10% toggle
checks.red_flag: M4-M7 PG pitch >80um at 28nm or >40um at 7nm, or hotspot >150um from bump, or PG strap cut by macro channel without stitching
checks.why_it_matters: PG fix after placement requires reroute of all signal layers; late IR fix adds 2 weeks and breaks timing

checks.question: Show me pin placement for top-level IO and feedthrough feasibility — are there >200 signals crossing the block with no feedthrough channel?
checks.evidence_demanded: Top-level flyline plot, feedthrough count vs available tracks, and IO pin assignment file
checks.red_flag: Feedthrough count >30% of available tracks in center or pins clustered on one edge forcing U-turn routes
checks.why_it_matters: Unroutable feedthrough becomes top-level congestion and timing failure that forces floorplan re-spin of neighboring blocks

checks.question: Show me utilization target and area headroom — what is initial placement utilization and is there 5-10% whitespace reserved for timing ECO?
checks.evidence_demanded: Utilization map target vs current, histogram of cell density, and whitespace allocation report
checks.red_flag: Target utilization >78% at 28nm or >68% at 7nm in first floorplan with no ECO space, or 0% whitespace in timing-critical region
checks.why_it_matters: No headroom means later setup fixes have nowhere to place buffers, leading to congestion spiral and schedule slip

checks.question: Show me hard-blockage map for CTS and routing — are clock root and clock gate regions free of placement blockage?
checks.evidence_demanded: CTS placement guide + routing blockage overlay, and clock tree root location
checks.red_flag: Clock root placed behind macro or inside 100% placement blockage, or clock gates placed at block edge far from fanout
checks.why_it_matters: CTS will detour with 2x insertion delay and 200ps extra skew, causing setup/hold wall that cannot be fixed without floorplan change

checks.question: Show me aspect ratio and pin-on-side for dataflow — does data flow go straight or does it fold 180 degrees?
checks.evidence_demanded: Dataflow arrow diagram from RTL hierarchy, and Manhattan distance vs flyline length estimate
checks.red_flag: Data enters left and exits left requiring U-turn across block, or aspect ratio 3:1 with dataflow across short side
checks.why_it_matters: Folding doubles wire length and net delay, guarantees timing failure at 1GHz+ and makes placement timing-driven but unfixable

checks.question: Show me DRC-relevant grid and technology constraints — are macros snapped to row and routing track, and are there any odd off-grid origins?
checks.evidence_demanded: Origin and macro origin report, grid snap check for M1-M2
checks.red_flag: Macro origin at 0.05um off manufacturing grid or macro rotation causing pin grid mismatch causing 1000s of unfixable short/spacing DRCs
checks.why_it_matters: Off-grid floorplan passes early checks but fails final DRC with thousands of violations that need full re-floorplan

kill_questions: What is the narrowest macro channel width and pin count on its edges? If <2 rows with >100 pins, stop review.
Where is the worst static IR estimate and distance to bump? If >100mV or >200um from bump, stop review.
waiver_culture: Teams waive pin alignment and channel width to hit schedule, promising 'router will handle it', then pay 2 weeks later moving macros after first detailed route fails with 5000 DRCs.

purpose: Catch placement-induced timing and congestion that CTS will lock in and amplify — once clocks are inserted, moving cells costs 3x

checks.question: Show me setup slack histogram by clock group at ideal clocks — is there a wall at -300ps or tail >500 paths with -200ps?
checks.evidence_demanded: Pre-CTS STA WNS/TNS histogram by clock group, with ideal clocks, no OCV, with cell-vs-net delay split
checks.red_flag: Wall at -300ps to -600ps with net delay >60% of path, or TNS >100ns indicating global constraint issue not local logic depth
checks.why_it_matters: If waved, CTS will add insertion delay and make wall worse; fixing after CTS requires re-placement and CTS redo, 1 week lost

checks.question: Show me congestion map global-route overflow and overflow by layer — where is overflow >1.5% and does it correlate with high pin density?
checks.evidence_demanded: Global route overflow map + overflow by layer + pin density heatmap
checks.red_flag: Overflow >2% concentrated in macro channels or >1% on single layer M3/M4, or overflow hotspot overlaps with timing-critical region
checks.why_it_matters: CTS adds clock buffers and will push overflow to >3%, causing detailed route to abort; fixing after CTS requires placement blockage and CTS rerun

checks.question: Show me placement utilization heatmap and bufferable whitespace — where can we still insert 1000 buffers for setup fixing?
checks.evidence_demanded: Density map 0-100% + free space map, and report of cells with >85% density
checks.red_flag: No whitespace <5% in worst slack region, or density >90% in timing-critical 50um x 50um window
checks.why_it_matters: Without whitespace, post-CTS optimization has nowhere to size or buffer, forcing floorplan expansion late

checks.question: Show me max fanout and max transition — are there nets with fanout >32 or transition >300ps at 28nm / >150ps at 7nm?
checks.evidence_demanded: Report max fanout, max cap, max transition by clock group
checks.red_flag: Fanout >40 or transition >400ps pre-CTS indicates buffering missed; will worsen after CTS due to added load
checks.why_it_matters: High fanout nets become hold and CTS blockage sources, and cause IR droop when they switch together

checks.question: Show me pin access DRC or placement DRC near timing-critical cells — are there any M1-M2 spacing violations at cell pins?
checks.evidence_demanded: Pin-access checker report or early detailed route DRC in timing-critical region
checks.red_flag: >20 pin-access violations involving same library cell type in critical region
checks.why_it_matters: Pin access issues become 5000 DRCs after detailed route, requiring cell swaps that break timing achieved pre-CTS

checks.question: Show me clock gate and sync cell placement — are clock gates placed at centroid of fanout and are sync flops grouped?
checks.evidence_demanded: Clock gate location vs fanout centroid plot, and clock domain map
checks.red_flag: Clock gate >100um from fanout centroid or gate driving >50% of clock domain from edge of block
checks.why_it_matters: Bad gating placement guarantees high skew and insertion delay, creates hold wall after CTS

checks.question: Show me IR drop map post-placement with 20% toggle — is dynamic IR >8% VDD anywhere?
checks.evidence_demanded: Dynamic IR map overlay with placement density, and power density map
checks.red_flag: Dynamic IR >80-100mV at 0.9V or >60mV at 0.75V in timing-critical region
checks.why_it_matters: High IR at pre-CTS means setup will degrade 50-100ps post-CTS when clock switches, causing unexpected WNS loss

checks.question: Show me don't-touch and ideal-networks that block optimization — are there leftover ideal nets from synthesis?
checks.evidence_demanded: Report of ideal nets, dont_touch cells, and size-only cells
checks.red_flag: >5% of cells marked dont_touch or clock nets still ideal in data path
checks.why_it_matters: Ideal nets hide real delay, so pre-CTS timing looks clean but post-CTS explodes when net delay added

kill_questions: What is WNS/TNS with ideal clocks and net-delay percentage? If WNS <-300ps with net delay >60%, stop and re-place.
Where is overflow >2%? If overflow overlaps worst timing region, stop and add placement blockage before CTS.
waiver_culture: Teams waive congestion map because 'CTS will spread cells', but CTS adds 10-15% more cells and makes congestion worse, forcing a loop back to placement 3 days later.

purpose: Catch constraint errors, OCV pessimism, and interface budget mismatches that pass block STA but fail top-level or silicon

checks.question: Show me constraint quality report — are there any unconstrained endpoints, missing input/output delays, or clocks without uncertainty?
checks.evidence_demanded: Constraint checker: unconstrained endpoints, no_input_delay, no_output_delay, missing clock groups, and set_false_path count
checks.red_flag: >0 unconstrained internal endpoints, or >5% of IOs with no input/output delay, or false paths >10% of total paths
checks.why_it_matters: Unconstrained paths are not checked at all; silicon failure with no STA violation, most expensive escape

checks.question: Show me WNS/TNS with PBA vs GBA, and with AOCV/POCV vs flat derate — how much is pessimism?
checks.evidence_demanded: PBA vs GBA slack delta, and flat derate vs AOCV/POCV report, and CRPR report
checks.red_flag: PBA recovers >30% of GBA WNS or derate >10% at 28nm / >8% at 7nm with no justification, or CRPR not enabled
checks.why_it_matters: Over-pessimism causes over-design 15% area/power and hides real violations under noise; under-pessimism causes silicon speed fail

checks.question: Show me interface timing budgets vs top-level — do block-level input/output delays match top-level STA with 0-wire?
checks.evidence_demanded: Top-level 0-wire timing with block as black box vs block-level IO budget spreadsheet, with launch/capture path sketch
checks.red_flag: Input delay + block internal + output delay sum exceeds period by >50ps, or budget assumes 0 wire delay for 500um top route
checks.why_it_matters: Budget mismatch passes block but fails top-level integration, requiring late re-budget and block ECO 1 week before tapeout

checks.question: Show me hold WNS with min corner and with OCV — is hold clean with realistic hold uncertainty?
checks.evidence_demanded: Hold report min corner, with hold uncertainty 50-100ps at 28nm / 30-60ps at 7nm, and clock domain crossing hold
checks.red_flag: Hold WNS <-20ps at min or hold fails only at interface with no inter-clock uncertainty
checks.why_it_matters: Hold failure in silicon cannot be fixed by lowering frequency; requires metal fix or software workaround

checks.question: Show me clock skew and insertion report by clock group — what is max skew and max insertion vs period?
checks.evidence_demanded: CTS QoR: skew, insertion, latency by clock, and useful skew report
checks.red_flag: Skew >12% of period or insertion >35% of period, or skew histogram bimodal indicating gating imbalance
checks.why_it_matters: High skew eats setup budget and creates hold wall; insertion >35% means clock power and IR risk high

checks.question: Show me EM and IR aware timing — what is timing after IR derate?
checks.evidence_demanded: IR-aware STA with instance-specific voltage drop, and EM report for clock and high-fanout nets
checks.red_flag: WNS degrades >80ps from nominal to IR-aware or EM violations >100 on clock trunk
checks.why_it_matters: Nominal timing clean but IR-aware fails in silicon at high temperature, causing speed bin loss

checks.question: Show me ECO count and last 2 weeks of timing trend — is WNS stable or bouncing?
checks.evidence_demanded: WNS/TNS trend chart over last 10 runs, and ECO change list
checks.red_flag: WNS bouncing +/-100ps each ECO or TNS improving while WNS degrades, indicating fix-one-break-one
checks.why_it_matters: Unstable timing indicates over-constrained or congestion-driven design that will not converge and will fail final signoff

kill_questions: Show me unconstrained endpoints and false path count. If any internal endpoint unconstrained or false path >10%, stop.
Show me interface budget vs top 0-wire. If sum > period, stop — block will fail at top.
waiver_culture: Teams waive hold at min corner promising 'we will fix hold at top', but hold at block is local and top cannot add delay inside block without breaking setup; results in metal-only ECO week after tapeout.

purpose: Catch DRCs that are unfixable by router and LVS/antenna that cause respin — final gate where waiver costs a mask

checks.question: Show me DRC count by layer and by type — are remaining DRCs systematic or random?
checks.evidence_demanded: DRC summary by layer and type (short, spacing, enclosure, min area) with map
checks.red_flag: >500 DRCs after 3 detail route iterations with same locations, or >80% on one layer M3/M4, or short/spacing at macro pins
checks.why_it_matters: Systematic DRCs at macro pins or one layer cannot be fixed by router iterations; require floorplan/cell change, blocking tapeout

checks.question: Show me LVS clean with correct extraction and with black-box macros — are there any shorts/opens due to floating pins?
checks.evidence_demanded: LVS report with extracted vs schematic count, and floating pin and short report
checks.red_flag: LVS not clean, or clean only with -blackbox macros that hide internal shorts, or >0 floating PG pins
checks.why_it_matters: LVS failure is functional failure; floating PG causes IR and latchup risk

checks.question: Show me antenna report — are there any nets with antenna ratio >400 at M1-M3 and no diode?
checks.evidence_demanded: Antenna ratio report by layer, with diode insertion report and jumper report
checks.red_flag: Antenna violations on clock or long signal nets >1000um without diode or jumper, especially at 28nm where gate oxide thinner
checks.why_it_matters: Antenna causes gate oxide damage during manufacturing, leading to reliability failure or yield loss, not detectable in STA

checks.question: Show me density and fill impact — what is metal density by layer and has fill been added?
checks.evidence_demanded: Metal density map pre- and post-fill, and timing delta with fill
checks.red_flag: Metal density <20% or >80% on any layer, or timing degrades >50ps after fill insertion
checks.why_it_matters: Density out of spec causes CMP dishing and etch variation, causing systematic yield loss; fill can add 30-80fF coupling hurting timing

checks.question: Show me ERC and latchup — any floating wells, missing well ties, or spacing < rule for latchup?
checks.evidence_demanded: ERC report: floating gate, floating well, missing tie, and latchup spacing check
checks.red_flag: Floating well or missing nwell/pwell tie >30um from tap, or well spacing violation near high-voltage domain
checks.why_it_matters: Latchup causes EOS failure and burn, floating well causes unpredictable VT and leakage

checks.question: Show me double-patterning and color compliance at 7nm — any odd-cycle or coloring violations?
checks.evidence_demanded: Double-patterning report, coloring check, and stitch count
checks.red_flag: Odd-cycle violations that require layout change, not just stitch insertion, especially on M1-M3
checks.why_it_matters: Coloring violations cannot be waived without mask change; stitch insertion may break timing

checks.question: Show me chip finishing — are all spare cells and decap inserted and tied, and is seal ring and scribe compliant?
checks.evidence_demanded: Spare cell count, decap density map, seal ring DRC, and scribe width check
checks.red_flag: Decap density <10% in IR hotspot or no spare cells for ECO, or seal ring spacing violation
checks.why_it_matters: No spare cells means any ECO requires full re-place; low decap means IR failure in silicon; seal ring violation is fab reject

kill_questions: Is LVS clean with full extraction including macros? If not, stop — no tapeout.
What is DRC count after final route and where? If >0 systematic DRCs at same macro pins after 3 iterations, stop — router cannot fix, need floorplan change.
waiver_culture: Teams waive antenna and density as 'foundry will fix with fill', but fill adds coupling that breaks timing by 50-100ps and antenna without diode causes gate damage and yield loss that shows only in volume production.
